title: Distinguishing three-round Feistel networks

problem.name: Distinguishing three-round Feistel networks
problem.statement_latex: Given coherent chosen-plaintext access to a $2n$-bit permutation, distinguish a three-round Feistel network built from independent random round functions from a uniformly random permutation. Complexity counts superposition oracle calls.
problem.statement_text: Given coherent chosen-plaintext access to a $2n$-bit permutation, distinguish a three-round Feistel network built from independent random round functions from a uniformly random permutation. Complexity counts superposition oracle calls.
